t1_exclusion_rationale: Only 179 prompts achievable (3-15 per category). Insufficient for fine-tuning.

edge_factual_dilution.description: borderline_edge_factual (130 records, no templates) is always included in full in every condition. In T5 this is 32.7% of the dataset. Since R{N} matches T5 category counts, R{N} also includes all 130 — these records are 100% identical between T5 and R{N}. The effective template-diversity comparison operates only over the ~267 non-edge records (50 vs ~194 templates).
edge_factual_dilution.mitigation: Report per-category evaluation metrics excluding edge_factual so the template-diversity effect on templated categories is visible. The 130 shared records add a constant baseline effect; they do not confound the direction of the comparison, only dilute its magnitude.

asymmetric_rn_labels.description: Matched random control labels differ per model: R397 (Mixtral, T5=397) vs R402 (Llama, T5=402). This reflects different unfixable counts per model (28 vs 24). Downstream scripts must handle model-dependent R{N} filenames.
asymmetric_rn_labels.mitigation: The ablation_report.json records exact condition names per model. Fine-tuning and evaluation scripts should read the report to resolve filenames rather than hardcoding.
